name: The Royal Livingstone Hotel Victoria Falls Zambia by Anantara
positioning: Safari-style hotel on the banks of the Zambezi River, a five-minute walk from Victoria Falls, with wildlife roaming its grounds
best_for: Travelers who want to walk to Victoria Falls from their hotel
Guests who want wildlife on the grounds and river views from their veranda

facts.text: The hotel sits on the banks of the Zambezi River with direct access to Victoria Falls, a five-minute walk away.
Zebras and other wildlife roam the hotel grounds.
The hotel is designed in a safari style.
Zambezi River and savannah views stretch from every veranda.
Rooms combine modern convenience with explorer-era charm and have private outdoor spaces.
Suites evoke Victorian-era grace and have private verandas with views of the Zambezi River.
Rooms and suites come with butler service.
Spa therapies are offered under the shade of monkey trees on the banks of the river.
Experiences include river safaris and helicopter waterfall excursions.
Nearby activities include Livingstone Island and Devil's Pool, a game drive, and a rhino walk.
The hotel offers dining under the monkey tree.
The hotel has an on-site gym and a running trail.
